root_cause_summary: Elevated operating temperature exceeding 180°C caused material thermal expansion and micro-fracturing during molding cycle.
corrective_action: Recalibrate thermal sensors and mandate visual QA when operating above 180°C.

root_cause_summary: Overheating of heat injection nozzle resulting in thermal stress cracks on container surface.
corrective_action: Replaced nozzle heating coil and updated SOP threshold alert.

root_cause_summary: Hydraulic pressure drop during clamping phase.
